description: Reference schema for the rag_evidence_embeddings pgvector table. Rows are produced by app.chunking.evidence_chunker.chunk_evd_json() using RecursiveJsonSplitter, then stored via app.db.pgvector_client.upsert_evidence_embeddings(). Evidence chunks carry per-section rule results (R001–R005) and label_weighted_coverage from the enterprise RAG validation pipeline.

splitter_config.description: Splits rule-based evidence JSON by section_evidences entries. One chunk per section evidence block, plus one summary chunk.

evidence_id.description: Short identifier: EVD_{jd_id[:8]}. Matches evidence_id field in rule_based_evidence_schema.

source_type.description: Origin of this evidence chunk. One of: rule_based (from current RAG validation run), historical (from prior validated runs).

section_name.description: Section this chunk covers (e.g. technologies, skills, experience) or 'summary' for the overall summary chunk.

chunk_text.description: Serialised JSON string of the chunk data produced by split_json_to_chunks()

chunk_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of chunk_text. Used for deduplication on upsert.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata attached by the chunker (e.g. evidence_id, section_name, verdict, rules_fired)

source_type_values.rule_based: Evidence produced by the current RAG validation run (rag_validation.py Steps 3–5). Reflects latest hybrid_search results and rule application for this candidate–JD pair.
source_type_values.historical: Evidence from prior validated runs stored for retrieval augmentation. Used to ground score adjustments against similar past cases.

rule_ids.R001_LOW_COVERAGE: label_weighted_coverage < importance-scaled threshold (max(15, 30/importance_factor)). Fires when the section's matched multiplier sum is below the threshold.
rule_ids.R002_OVERESTIMATION: AI score awarded exceeds ground truth (label_weighted_coverage × weight / 100) by more than the tolerance band.
rule_ids.R003_DENSE_BM25_DIVERGENCE: Dense similarity and BM25 score diverge significantly, indicating the semantic match is unconfirmed by exact token overlap.
rule_ids.R004_NO_EXACT_HIGH_HYBRID: hybrid_score is high but exact_match_ratio is near zero — likely semantic false positive with no token-level confirmation.
rule_ids.R005_MANDATORY_UNMATCHED: One or more criteria with reasoning_label in {mandatory_core_skill, critical_requirement} were NOT found in resume text. Triggers 30% knockdown in score_adjustment.py.

coverage_metric.name: label_weighted_coverage
coverage_metric.description: Primary ground-truth coverage metric for enterprise JDs. Weights matched criteria by their ontology multiplier instead of flat match count.
coverage_metric.fallback: Falls back to hybrid_score × 100 for legacy plain-number criteria where no multiplier budget exists.
coverage_metric.note: Stored as coverage_pct in section_evidence chunks (rule_based_evidence_schema). Used as ground_truth_score input to _run_mathematical_validation() in Step 4.

per_section_chunk.text: {"evidence_id": "EVD_a1b2c3d4", "section_name": "technologies", "section_weight": 22.5, "rule_type": "hybrid_search_validated", "coverage_pct": 78.4, "ai_score": 18.9, "ground_truth_score": 17.6, "score_delta": 1.3, "verdict": "ACCURATE", "criteria_evaluated": [{"criterion": "Python", "criterion_weight": 100.0, "matched": true, "evidence": "Senior Python developer with 6 years experience"}, {"criterion": "FastAPI", "criterion_weight": 95.0, "matched": true, "evidence": "Built REST APIs using FastAPI"}, {"criterion": "Docker", "criterion_weight": 80.0, "matched": false, "evidence": ""}, {"criterion": "Kubernetes", "criterion_weight": 70.0, "matched": false, "evidence": ""}], "total_criteria": 4, "matched_count": 2, "applied_rules": [{"rule_id": "R001_LOW_COVERAGE", "description": "Low label-weighted coverage", "fired": false, "condition_evaluation": "coverage=78.4% >= threshold=23.1%", "action_applied": {"explanation": "No action", "score_after": 18.9}}, {"rule_id": "R005_MANDATORY_UNMATCHED", "description": "Mandatory criteria unmatched", "fired": false, "condition_evaluation": "mandatory_unmatched=[]", "action_applied": {"explanation": "No action", "score_after": 18.9}}], "source": "rule_based", "chunk_index": 0, "chunk_hash": "x1y2..."}
per_section_chunk.notes: One chunk per section_evidence entry from rule_based_evidence_schema. coverage_pct = label_weighted_coverage. Criteria reflect enterprise rich-dict weight (criterion_weight = criteria score 0–100).

per_section_chunk_r005_fired.text: {"evidence_id": "EVD_a1b2c3d4", "section_name": "skills", "section_weight": 19.1, "rule_type": "hybrid_search_validated", "coverage_pct": 31.5, "ai_score": 14.2, "ground_truth_score": 6.0, "score_delta": 8.2, "verdict": "OVERESTIMATED", "criteria_evaluated": [{"criterion": "LangGraph", "criterion_weight": 100.0, "matched": false, "evidence": ""}, {"criterion": "RAG pipeline design", "criterion_weight": 95.0, "matched": false, "evidence": ""}, {"criterion": "vector search", "criterion_weight": 80.0, "matched": true, "evidence": "pgvector implementation"}], "total_criteria": 3, "matched_count": 1, "applied_rules": [{"rule_id": "R002_OVERESTIMATION", "description": "AI overestimated section score", "fired": true, "condition_evaluation": "ai=14.2 > gt=6.0 (delta=8.2)", "action_applied": {"explanation": "Score clamped to ground truth", "score_after": 6.0}}, {"rule_id": "R005_MANDATORY_UNMATCHED", "description": "Mandatory criteria unmatched", "fired": true, "condition_evaluation": "mandatory_unmatched=[LangGraph, RAG pipeline design]", "action_applied": {"explanation": "R005 penalty: 30% knockdown applied in score_adjustment", "score_after": 4.2}}], "source": "rule_based", "chunk_index": 1, "chunk_hash": "y3z4..."}
per_section_chunk_r005_fired.notes: Example with R002 and R005 both fired. mandatory_unmatched lists criteria with mandatory_core_skill or critical_requirement labels absent from resume text.

summary_chunk.text: {"evidence_id": "EVD_a1b2c3d4", "timestamp": "2026-05-21T10:30:00Z", "job_id": "JD_001", "job_title": "Senior Backend Engineer", "overall_summary": {"total_sections": 8, "sections_with_overestimation": 2, "sections_with_underestimation": 0, "sections_accurate": 6, "ai_final_score": 74.3, "rule_based_final_score": 68.9, "delta": 5.4}, "rule_applications": {"total_rules_generated": 5, "rule_log": [{"rule_id": "R002_OVERESTIMATION", "fired": true, "condition_evaluation": "skills: ai=14.2 > gt=6.0"}, {"rule_id": "R005_MANDATORY_UNMATCHED", "fired": true, "condition_evaluation": "mandatory_unmatched=[LangGraph, RAG pipeline design]"}]}, "source": "rule_based", "chunk_index": 8, "chunk_hash": "z5a6..."}
summary_chunk.notes: One summary chunk per evidence document. Contains overall_summary and flat rule_log. section_name = 'summary'.

schema.text: string — serialised JSON string of chunk data
schema.chunk_index: integer — 0-based index within this evidence document
schema.chunk_hash: string — SHA-256 hex of text field

extra_fields_from_evidence_chunker.evidence_id: string — propagated from the evidence document root

search_result_row.description: Row format returned by app.db.pgvector_client.search_evidence_embeddings(evidence_id, query_embedding, section_name, source_type, top_k)

upsert_behaviour.on_conflict: DO UPDATE SET embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding, chunk_text = EXCLUDED.chunk_text, source_type = EXCLUDED.source_type, section_name = EXCLUDED.section_name, metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
upsert_behaviour.description: Idempotent upsert. Re-running RAG validation for the same evidence_id replaces chunks where rule output or coverage changed.

pipeline_position.produced_by: rag_validation.py Steps 3–5 (deterministic validation + rule application + evidence assembly)
consumed_by: score_adjustment.py — reads section-level coverage_pct and applied_rules (especially R005) to constrain AI scores
explanation_gen.py — reads scoring_trace.label_weighted_coverage and validation status for explanation text
report_generator.py — reads importance_weighted_mae and jd_weights_math_valid for PDF verdict block
pipeline_position.label_weighted_coverage_flow: rag_validation computes label_weighted_coverage per section → stored as coverage_pct in evidence chunk → used as ground_truth_score in Step 4 → propagated to scoring_trace in score_adjustment → surfaced in explanation and PDF report
